source_refs.note: 14.16.1 Economic Issues: a main subheading of 14.16 Economic, social and political issues, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 319-319.

items: Poor air quality can reduce worker productivity due to illness and absenteeism.
Air pollution and air quality can damage crops reducing agricultural yield and increasing food prices.
Air pollution leading to acid rain can degrade buildings, bridges and other infrastructure.
